articles.title: National Bank Holdings Balances Vista Deal Digital Push And Capital Returns

articles.summary: Simply Wall St.: National Bank Holdings Balances Vista Deal Digital Push And Capital Returns. National Bank Holdings (NYSE:NBHC) has completed its acquisition of Vista Bank and integrated operations in Texas. The company has launched the first phase of its new 2UniFi digital banking platform focused on small business clients. NBHC announced a 3.2% dividend increase and authorized a US$100 million share repurchase program.
